name: Model Casting
detailed_description:
Gameplay and Features:

Three Distinct Chapters for Each Model:

  • The Interview:

    • Get to Know Her: Discover the model's background, personality, and reasons for joining the agency.

    • Light Intimacy: Encourage her to show some skin or participate in a sensual photoshoot, setting the stage for future encounters.

  • First Meeting:

    • Deepen the Connection: The model returns seeking a favor or negotiating her contract.

    • First Full Encounter: Use your charm to navigate the conversation into a passionate and explicit scene where boundaries are pushed.

  • Lewd Visit (Sandbox Mode):

    • Total Control: Revisit previous H-scenes or unlock new, more explicit content based on your relationship level.

    • Explore New Fantasies: Choose from various scenarios, outfits, and settings to create unique experiences.

Meet the Models:

Chloe – The College Girl:

  • Shy and innocent, yet secretly intrigued by the adult world. She opens up as she feels more comfortable, revealing a playful side.

Lana – The Unsuccessful Actress:

  • Bold and self-assured, using her charm and body to negotiate. Despite her confidence, she seeks recognition and success.

Maya – The Go-Getter:

  • Direct and focused on financial gain. She's here for the money but isn't opposed to fun once she lets her guard down.

Sasha – The Yoga Instructor:

  • Calm and in tune with her body. Prefers a slow, sensual buildup and values genuine connections.

Emma – The Gamer Girl:

  • Casual and straightforward, lacking traditional social skills but open to new experiences. She's here to fund her gaming passion.

Dive into the World of Model Casting:

  • Become the Decision-Maker: As the agency owner, your choices directly impact the models' careers and your relationships with them.

  • Explore Intimate Narratives: Each model offers a unique storyline filled with personal challenges, desires, and opportunities for connection.

Are You Ready to Lead the Ultimate Modeling Agency?

Step into a world where every decision matters, and every interaction can lead to new heights of intimacy and success. Whether you choose to be a supportive mentor or a confident negotiator, the path you take will shape your agency's future and the destinies of the models who rely on you.

content_descriptors.notes:
Model Casting is an adult visual novel designed for mature audiences and features explicit sexual content, nudity, and strong language. Players interact with fictional characters in scenarios that include suggestive photoshoots, intimate dialogues, and consensual sexual encounters. All characters depicted in the game are 18 years or older.

The mature content is presented as part of the storyline and character development, focusing on consensual relationships and mutual respect. The game does not include depictions of sexual assault, non-consensual acts, extreme violence, self-harm, or drug/alcohol abuse. Instead, it aims to provide an immersive, character-driven experience that explores adult themes in a thoughtful and engaging manner.
